newsitem.title: USA: Baltimore Gas awards $75 mln coal contract.
newsitem.headline: Baltimore Gas awards $75 mln coal contract.

text.p: Baltimore Gas and Electric Co said on Friday it awarded Southeast Fuels Inc a seven-year, $75 million coal delivery contract, as part of a plan to do more business with minority and women-owned vendors.
North Carolina-based Southeast Fuels would supply Baltimore Gas with 400,000 tons of coal each year for the next seven years, the company said in a statement.

"This contract is BGE's largest ever with a minority vndor and it significantly contributes to BGE's ongoing efforts to provide minority and women-owned business enterprises equal access to its purchasing opportunities," the company said.
